explanation: The page says only that BFM showed at least 12.5% of [0,∞) lies in S. The docstring gives the underlying Theorem 1.1: for nonnegative β_1 ≤ … ≤ β_9, some difference β_j − β_i with i < j lies in S. The Lean statement encodes that with `Monotone` on Fin 9. It matches my recollection of the theorem, but I did not read the paper here, so the attribution of the exact form is unverified. Equal βs are harmless since 0 ∈ S.
